value.text: A resource has no more than one value of skos:prefLabel per language tag, and no more than one value of skos:prefLabel without language tag.
The range of skos:prefLabel is the class of RDF plain literals.

skos:prefLabel, skos:altLabel and skos:hiddenLabel are pairwise
      disjoint properties.
The preferred lexical label for a resource, in a given language.
Broader concepts are typically rendered as parents in a concept hierarchy (tree).
Relates a concept to a concept that is more general in meaning.
Narrower concepts are typically rendered as children in a concept hierarchy (tree).
Relates a concept to a concept that is more specific in meaning.
Relates a concept to a concept with which there is an associative semantic relationship.
The range of skos:altLabel is the class of RDF plain literals.
skos:prefLabel, skos:altLabel and skos:hiddenLabel are pairwise disjoint properties.
An alternative lexical label for a resource.
